title: Common Changing Habits Degrading Ev Battery
report:
Here is a 4-sentence summary and 5 key facts about the news:

**Summary:** Electric vehicle (EV) owners can extend the life of their car's battery by adopting simple charging habits. Avoiding full charges, keeping the battery level between 20-80%, and charging in moderate temperatures can make a big difference. Additionally, limiting the use of high-speed Level 3 charging can also help prolong battery life. By following these best practices, EV owners can maintain their car's range and performance over time.

**Key Facts:**

1. **Avoid full charges**: EV owners should avoid charging their car to 100% every time, and instead aim to keep the battery level between 20-80%.
2. **Different battery types have different needs**: Lithium iron phosphate (LFP) batteries should only be fully charged once a week, while nickel manganese cobalt (NMC) systems should be kept at 80-90% most of the time.
3. **Temperature matters**: Charging in high heat (above 104°F/40°C) can accelerate battery degradation, while cold temperatures can make charging inefficient.
4. **Level 3 charging should be limited**: High-speed Level 3 charging should only be used when necessary, such as on long trips when time is of the essence.
5. **Modern EVs and chargers can help**: Many modern EVs and chargers allow owners to set fixed percentage caps, making it easier to adopt good charging habits and prolong battery life.
